correctness.rationale: The exact binary open-neighbor update on C_n Cartesian K_2 becomes [[d,1],[0,d]] over F2[z]/(z^n+1) with d=(z^2+z+1)/z. The sole singular factor z^2+z+1 occurs with multiplicity k=2^v2(n) exactly when 3 divides n. The P-primary part has binary dimension 4k and nilpotent index 2 if k=1, otherwise k; its kernel dimensions are explicitly derived by solving the triangular equations. Chinese remainders give the complement, transient distribution, and basin sizes. The m-th fixed-point equation has Smith factors (f,f) if m is even and (1,f^2) if m is odd; multiplication-kernel dimensions yield the stated polynomial-gcd counts for every m. Möbius inversion gives primitive cycles. Independent matrix-rank and polynomial implementations agree on 726 tests for n=3..24, and direct trajectory enumeration agrees on all 87,360 configurations for n=3..8. These finite tests corroborate the algebraic infinite proof, not replace it.

value.rationale: The cubic circular prism is a canonical natural family, with parity dynamics fundamental to graph cellular automata. Its reversibility flips exactly on divisibility by three, while singular sizes have unbounded sharp transient depth governed by a power of two. A striking 15/16 proportion of maximal-transient initial states is uniform for all even multiples of three. Complete recurrent-state and basin counts plus exact formulas for every temporal primitive period make this a nontrivial infinite-family dynamical classification beyond a determinant calculation; its significance is internal and not predicated on speculative applications.
